commands.name: Initiate LTE Multi Evaluation
commands.description: Starts the LTE Multi Evaluation measurement.
commands.source: CMW LTE UE User Manual Rev.22 extracted text around line 31958.
commands.manual_section: LTE Multi Evaluation Measurement - Remote Commands
commands.notes: Measurement instance <i> must be expanded before execution.

commands.name: Stop LTE Multi Evaluation
commands.description: Stops the LTE Multi Evaluation measurement.
commands.source: CMW LTE UE User Manual Rev.22 extracted text around line 31960.
commands.manual_section: LTE Multi Evaluation Measurement - Remote Commands
commands.notes: Do not execute as part of a generic safe probe.

commands.name: Abort LTE Multi Evaluation
commands.description: Aborts the LTE Multi Evaluation measurement.
commands.source: CMW LTE UE User Manual Rev.22 extracted text around line 31959.
commands.manual_section: LTE Multi Evaluation Measurement - Remote Commands
commands.notes: Application-level abort; intentionally not mapped to InstrumentDriver.abort().

commands.name: LTE Multi Evaluation State
commands.description: Queries the current state of LTE Multi Evaluation.
commands.source: CMW LTE UE User Manual Rev.22 extracted text around line 31961.
commands.manual_section: LTE Multi Evaluation Measurement - Remote Commands
commands.notes: Safe query, but disabled from generic probe because measurement instance <i> must be selected.
commands.response_notes: Hardware observed values include OFF and RDY.

commands.name: LTE Multi Evaluation All States
commands.description: Queries detailed state information for LTE Multi Evaluation.
commands.source: CMW LTE UE User Manual Rev.22 extracted text around line 31962.
commands.manual_section: LTE Multi Evaluation Measurement - Remote Commands
commands.notes: Response format must be captured on real LTE 3.5.50 hardware.
commands.response_notes: Hardware observed responses include OFF,INV,INV and RDY,ADJ,INV.
